channel.title: GATE Guide — free GATE 2027 guides
channel.description: Free GATE 2027 guides for CSE, ECE, CE, DA, EE and ME: syllabus, weightage, important topics and preparation, by MD ANISH AHAMAD.

item.title: GATE EE 2027 Exam Pattern and Marking Scheme
item.description: GATE EE 2027 exam pattern explained: 65 questions, 100 marks, 3 hours, General Aptitude at 15 marks, and how MCQ, MSQ and NAT questions are marked.

item.title: GATE ME 2027 New Topics: Transmissibility, PID, Boiling and More
item.description: Every topic newly named in the GATE ME 2027 syllabus, from transmissibility and PID control to boiling, combustion and six sigma, and how much to read.

item.title: GATE ECE Qualifying Marks and Cutoffs Explained
item.description: GATE ECE qualifying marks for 2024, 2025 and 2026 from the official cut-off pages, the formula that sets them, and how admission cutoffs differ.

item.title: GATE DA 2027 Exam Pattern and Marking Scheme
item.description: GATE DA exam pattern for 2027 explained, with 65 questions, 100 marks, the fixed 15-mark aptitude block, MCQ, MSQ and NAT counts, and negative marking rules.

item.title: Paging and TLB Questions in GATE CSE: Levels, Bits and EAT
item.description: How GATE CSE asks paging questions. Page-table size, number of levels, the address bit split, TLB effective access time, TLB reach and inverted page tables.

item.title: Geotechnical Engineering for GATE CE 2027: Important Topics
item.description: GATE CE Geotechnical Engineering important topics for 2027, counted from all sixteen papers of 2019 to 2026. The steadiest heavy section and what changed.

item.title: GATE EE 2027 Syllabus Changes: What Changed From 2026
item.description: GATE EE 2027 syllabus changes, checked word by word against 2026. No phrase added, removed or reworded; one spelling corrected. What that means for you.

item.title: Signals and Systems for GATE ECE 2027: Important Topics

item.title: Hashing Questions in GATE CSE: Probing, Load Factor and Traps

item.title: Number Representation Questions in GATE CSE Digital Logic
item.description: How GATE CSE asks number representation questions: two's complement range and overflow, sign extension, and IEEE 754 bias, denormals and precision.

item.title: Structural Engineering for GATE CE 2027: Important Topics
item.description: GATE CE Structural Engineering important topics for 2027, from all sixteen papers of 2019 to 2026. Where the marks sit and what the syllabus dropped.

item.title: GATE CSE Subnetting Questions: CIDR, Masks and Forwarding
item.description: How GATE CSE asks subnetting questions. CIDR prefixes, subnet masks, usable host counts, network and broadcast addresses, and longest prefix match.

item.title: GATE CE Set 1 vs Set 2: What Two Papers a Year Means
item.description: GATE CE Set 1 vs Set 2 explained from sixteen counted papers, 2019 to 2026 - how far the two sets differed, MSQ counts per set, and what normalisation does.

item.title: Sliding Window Questions in GATE CSE: Efficiency and Window Size

item.title: GATE CE 2027 Syllabus: Topics Removed and What to Do

item.title: GATE CE Previous Year Papers: What 16 Papers Actually Show

item.title: Process Synchronization Questions in GATE CSE: Method and Traps
item.description: How GATE CSE asks process synchronization questions. Semaphores, mutual exclusion, progress, bounded waiting, producer-consumer and counter races.

item.title: GATE CE 2027 Preparation Strategy: A Plan Ordered by Marks
item.description: A GATE CE 2027 preparation strategy built on sixteen counted papers, with week shapes for 20-week, 8-week and 2-week candidates and what to skip.
